title: Implement Memory decision effectiveness and recurrence lifecycle

intent.outcome: Make Memory use truthful and decision-bound, then classify material recurrence through existing consequences and stronger-owner lifecycle review.
non_goals: Do not create a Memory compliance ledger, policy engine, broad note dump, prose-keyword matcher, or per-use receipt.
Do not grant advisory Memory Planning or action-safety authority.
Do not treat agent self-report or generic route discovery as proof of use or effectiveness.

owned: truthful Memory candidate, projected, unresolved, stale, dismissed, and unavailable states
compact durable-fact projection into the canonical operating decision
fact/revision/decision-bound recurrence classification and existing consequence routing
executable stronger-owner and retain/shrink/stub/delete lifecycle review
captured active-plan failure replay, cross-surface identity, quiet-path, authority, and cost fixtures
release metadata and target-branch integration proposals
effects: High-confidence structured matches reach the affected decision without a second Memory command.
Candidate discovery is never reported as consultation or application.
Material recurrence is attributed honestly and deterministic lessons can converge on a stronger owner.

refs: 261 Memory package tests passed with one skip
contract tooling, structured inventory, schema references, Ruff, typecheck, and runtime ownership checks passed

delegation.reason: This lane has one tightly coupled decision/projection owner, and this session does not authorize sub-agent delegation.

next_action: Publish the final stacked draft PR and let the target-branch integration proposal archive this owner after merge.

claims: Implement Memory decision effectiveness and recurrence lifecycle is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
requirements: Run Memory package tests, Agentic Workspace changed-path proof, contract tooling, lint, type checking, and ownership checks before integration.
